name: arcmira-transcript-search
title: YouTube Transcript Search by Arcmira
author: Arcmira <https://arcmira.com>
description: Find timestamped passages in indexed YouTube videos and podcasts with the Arcmira API. Requires a server-side ARCMIRA_API_KEY.
docs: Set ARCMIRA_API_KEY on the server. Import arcmiraTranscriptSearch from the installed tool file and include it in your AI SDK tools. API documentation: https://arcmira.com/docs
